title: Sacks of Wheat on Order
summary: Hilde Harrow says Isolt Charnock has an order for 4 sacks of wheat that cannot wait. The stock is at the mill yard, and the deadline is before the tithe collector counts the barns.
offer_text: "Isolt Charnock has an order and nobody to fetch it. Hear Isolt out, then bring the goods from the mill yard before the tithe collector counts the barns. I will vouch for you."

objectives.text: Take 4 sacks of wheat from the mill yard
Hand the sacks of wheat to Isolt Charnock
